steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow selected by the case.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Enter the title with leading and trailing spaces to exercise trimming.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's default variant should populate automatically.
Verify that the requested product line was added.
Choose the specified delivery location in the sheet.
Verify the delivery location was selected.
Add one available QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Save the event and publish it.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Return to the events list to inspect the saved event title.
Verify the event appears in the list under the title without the outer spaces.
